pages.title: ORSA EVA Survival Suit
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA Mk.III Extra-Vehicular Activity Suit$()$(br2)The pinnacle of ORSA engineering. Sealed air loop, cryogenic insulation, and a Frozen Heart power core. Provides $(bold)cold resistance through Phase 5-6$() and keeps you functional in late Phase 6 only when you also have breathable air or O2 support.$(br2)$(italic)This suit costs more than your house. Your old house. The one that's now a glacier.$()

pages.title: Specifications
pages.text: $(bold)Protection:$() Each piece adds +30°C. Full set provides $(bold)+120°C total$().$(br2)$(bold)Rated for:$() Phase 1-6 surface cold$(br)$(bold)Bonus:$() Negates wind chill.$(br)$(bold)Limitation:$() In late Phase 6, a full EVA suit still needs breathable air: stay inside a sealed room or habitable oxygen zone, or carry $(l:orsa_equipment/o2_canisters)O2 Canisters$(/l) to survive outside.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA Legal: This suit is on loan. Returning it in pieces counts as "damaged."$()

pages.title: Crafting Notes
pages.text: Requires Tier 2 heavy insulation as a base, ice shards, blue ice, and — for the chestplate — a $(bold)Frozen Heart$() power core.$(br2)Yes, you need to brave the frozen surface to gather materials. Yes, we see the problem.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA Engineering: "It builds character."$()

pages.title: Caldera Retrofit
pages.text: RUPTURE calderas run hot enough to cook a standard EVA shell from the inside.$(br2)If you already have an $(l:orsa_rd/lined_eva)Acheronite-Lined EVA Suit$(/l), combine it with $(bold)Sulfur Crust$() and $(bold)Volcanic Tuff$() to add a caloric barrier.$(br2)The retrofit suppresses caldera overheat, but it does $(bold)not$() protect against direct lava contact.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA Materials: If the suit starts smelling like minerals and bad decisions, the seal probably took.$()

pages.title: Hull Integrity
pages.text: In vacuum, physical impacts can $(bold)puncture a sealed EVA suit$(). A breach vents carried O2; two breaches drain twice as fast. Cold, hunger, and suffocation cannot create punctures.$(br2)Hold $(item)Tattered Clothing Scrap$() to improvise a slow seal. It may fail later. An $(item)ORSA Suit Patch Kit$() seals one breach quickly and permanently. External damage interrupts either repair.$(br2)Breaches stop venting in breathable shelter, but remain until patched.
The chestplate requires a Frozen Heart core. Don't worry, it's not YOUR heart.
Blue ice, ice shards, and a reinforced helmet. Breathing easier starts at the top.
Mobility matters when the surface is trying to kill you. These keep up.
Seal the suit from the ground up. Vacuum is a terrible thing to step into.

pages.title: ORSA Suit Patch Kit
pages.text: A permanent pressure seal. Intact Major Hearths may also contain salvaged kits, assuming the collective permits recovery.

pages.title: Caldera Retrofit
pages.text: Retrofit an Acheronite-Lined EVA Suit with Sulfur Crust and Volcanic Tuff. If the upgraded shell reads $(italic)Caldera retrofit installed.$(), the barrier took.
